characters.description: A recovering silver-rank adventurer whose near-fatal portal rescue exposed his aura over Rimaros. He seeks a quieter public identity while learning to control an altered soul, a transformed cloud refuge, and powers that make secrecy difficult.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: An Earth outworlder in Jason's circle who is still bronze rank.
characters.name: Taika

characters.description: A senior member of the Rimaros family whose involvement is part of the proposed explanation for Jason's public departure.
characters.name: Soramir Rimaros

characters.description: Jason's mobile-striker teammate. She wants accountability from the person responsible for Jason's abduction and forced starseed implantation.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: A tailor who opens his highly warded shop to Jason's group for a confidential meeting.
characters.name: Alorando Albarici

characters.description: An infiltrator and tactical specialist on Jason's team. Her earlier covert work helped recover a mining heir before the Order could complete its transformation of him.
characters.name: Belinda Callahan

characters.description: An ally whose recorded plan replaces a false auxiliary list with the people and roles intended to support Jason's cover identity.
characters.name: Dawn

characters.description: A veteran adventurer proposed as a trainer within Jason's new auxiliary structure. His experience and judgment make him both an instructor and a trusted ally.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A gold-rank survivor of severe soul trauma who agrees to teach Jason practical soul and aura control while travelling with his nephew's team.
characters.name: Amos Pensinata

characters.description: A healer-researcher proposed to study people altered by the Order of Redeeming Light. Jason values his expertise but refuses to house research prisoners inside his soul space.
characters.name: Carlos Quilido

characters.description: A Rimaros royal and combat adventurer. Jason rejects placing her among his cover identity's auxiliaries because the position is meant for support specialists.
characters.name: Zara Rimaros

characters.description: An adventurer attempting to bind a replacement magical-frog familiar after her previous familiar died defending Rimaros.
characters.name: Autumn

characters.description: Jason's many-bodied shadow familiar, providing concealment, restraint, scouting, and movement while Jason dismantles the teams hunting him without killing them.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason's blood-based familiar. Colin can manifest predatory leeches and assists in overpowering enemies during Jason's response to the hunters.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Jason's eye-like familiar, whose force attacks break magical barriers during the hunter operation.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Jason's teammate and field leader. He protects the group's cover, weighs risks for the whole party, and directs its practical response to emerging threats.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: Humphrey’s familiar, a dragon able to assume other shapes, including a giant hydra form.
characters.name: Stash

characters.description: A silver-rank Adventure Society official proposed to serve as the liaison for Jason's team.
characters.name: Vidal Ladiv

characters.description: A royal adventurer who manages the political consequences of Jason's staged identity and tries to contain the damage his circle can cause at court.
characters.name: Liara Rimaros

characters.description: A healer and mental-health specialist connected to Jason's allies. She asks for a private discussion about Callum's unusually urgent concern for Jason's prisoner.
characters.name: Arabelle Remore

characters.description: Someone whose unusually urgent concern for Jason’s prisoner prompts Arabelle to request a private discussion with Jason.
characters.name: Callum

characters.description: Jason's Leonid ally, whose forceful response to a ballroom provocation becomes the pretext for an attempted political duel.
characters.name: Gareth Xandier

characters.description: The creator of the weapon credited with destroying the Builder's flying city, earning the gratitude of House Rimaros.
characters.name: Travis Noble

characters.description: Jason's former field teammate and close confidante. She challenges his return to the violent habits he developed on Earth and urges him to leave Rimaros.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin

characters.description: An altered prisoner confined in Jason's cloud pagoda. She survives the pagoda's collapse but remains in custody when Shade prevents her from leaving.
characters.name: Melody Jane

characters.description: An astral-magic researcher and combat caster travelling with Jason's group. He applies methodical magical analysis to the threats the convoy encounters.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: The healer on Jason's adventuring team, responsible for keeping the group functional when its contracts turn dangerous.
characters.name: Neil Devone

characters.description: The leader of a six-person silver-rank team travelling alongside Jason's convoy. She seeks independent field experience for her team rather than relying on constant gold-rank supervision.
characters.name: Corinne Peskos

characters.description: A mining heir whose interrupted transformation has left him unconscious in specialised containment. Carlos keeps him stable while investigating whether his condition can help reveal a treatment for other altered victims.
characters.name: Gibson Amouz

characters.description: The identity Jason Asano uses when he registers as Team Biscuit's silver-rank cook at the Cartes operations camp.
characters.name: John Miller

characters.description: The convoy's advance scout. She evaluates damaged regions and identifies where the adventurers' combat abilities can provide useful help rather than burdening settlements that mainly need supplies.
characters.name: Estella

characters.description: The former royal claimant now using her mother's family name. After withdrawing from the succession contest, she joins Corinne's team while seeking a life apart from her former political identity.
characters.name: Zara Noreen

characters.description: A treasure hunter who recognises Jason beneath his John Miller cover and chooses not to expose him.
characters.name: Amir Bahadir

characters.description: Amir Bahadir's wife and chief of staff. A gold-ranker, she joins his meeting with Jason's team.
characters.name: Constance

characters.description: A silver-rank messenger who handles an exposed local agent. He detects Jason's shadow surveillance and attacks through the familiar link.
characters.name: Lord Fal

characters.description: A gold-rank messenger leader who holds the title Voice of the Will and commands a silver-rank subordinate.
characters.name: Voice of the Will

characters.description: The leader of Yoresh's refugee response and a specialist in directing care for severe trauma. She investigates the Cloud Hospital while weighing its aid against the danger she senses within it.
characters.name: High Priestess of the Healer

characters.description: Clive's familiar, able to expand his shell into a flying transport and protected combat platform for the team during Yoresh's defence.
characters.name: Onslow

characters.description: A cautious gold-rank messenger officer directing the assault on Yoresh's entertainment district. He prioritises the survival of his forces while assessing Jason's growing threat.
characters.name: Gold-rank messenger commander

characters.description: A near-transcendent elf who intervenes outside normal time to stop a diamond-rank messenger from reaching Jason.
characters.name: Wraith

characters.description: An eighteen-year-old silver-rank messenger whose soul-shell power isolates Jason and suppresses most magic. She enters the inescapable duel intending to kill him through pain, fear, and close combat.
characters.name: Terra June Castor

characters.description: A messenger who accompanies the gold-rank commander and their people in seeking asylum from Jason.
characters.name: Messenger defector companion
